b: Your template is one HTML fragment. Every Tailwind utility works (Play CDN). The slide is 80rem wide, so text-6xl is always the same size relative to the slide.
Use bg-bg, text-fg, text-muted, bg-panel, border-rule, bg-chip, text-accent / bg-accent (and opacity: bg-accent/30). They follow the deck theme, dark/light mode and accent.
font-head, font-body and font-mono map to the deck font pairing.
{{title}} {{kicker}} {{body}} {{image}} {{code}} come from the slide Markdown. Values are HTML-escaped.
{{#items}} … {{/items}} repeats for each row of the first block (cards, stats, flow, list). Inside: {{icon}} {{title}} {{text}} {{index}}.
{{#image}}…{{/image}} renders only if set; {{^image}}…{{/image}} renders when empty — use it for placeholders.
Phosphor classes: or a fixed one like ph ph-rocket.
JSON with id, name, category, author, slots, description. id becomes the layout name: <!-- layout: custom:your-id -->.
No external scripts or fetches, no fixed pixel sizes over the slide, must look right in dark and light, and in 16:9 and 4:3.

Save keeps it in your templates. Submit to community opens a pull request on the md2slides repo adding community/templates/<id>/ (template.html, deck.md, meta.json), forking it for you if needed. Once merged, everyone gets the layout.
